I presented "Reimagining research papers as interactive and reliable #AI  agents" in our journal club today. And it's a game-changer. 

I already created two agents for HDStIM and Seurat, and they performed so well without me writing even a single line of code. All I had to do was point the data to the AI agent and ask it to carry out the analysis using the ChatGPT Codex interface. 

This can be great for testing new methods and code without installing.

#agenticai #LLM
